title: HostOperatorAlertDocument
description: One staff alert receipt per source: a new support conversation, a support message after four quiet hours, or a new lead. Created before any email is sent, so a retried trigger never sends twice. Holds ids, links and the outcome only: no names, contact details or message text.

alertId.description: lead_<intentId>, or support_ and the SHA-256 of the message path.

kind.description: supportConversation: the first message of a new conversation. supportReturn: an inbound message after four hours with none. The rest are new salesInboundIntents by source.

adminPath.description: The Admin route the email links to.

windowId.description: The UTC clock hour (yyyyMMddHH) whose hourly cap this alert counted against.

status.description: sending: reserved, email in flight (left as is if the run dies, never resent). overflow: over the hourly cap, listed in that hour's summary instead. unknown: the provider may or may not have sent it; never retried.

acceptedCount.description: Recipients on the accepted email (0 until accepted).
